name: plato-vscode
description: Plato VS Code extension — thin shell over @applivity/plato-core

scripts.test: node -e "console.log('no unit tests in the shell; core carries the logic')"

plato.connections.description: Named OpenAI-compatible/Anthropic connections (D26a). Built-in defaults: anthropic (native), openai (api.openai.com/v1). Example: [{"id":"litellm","kind":"openai","baseUrl":"http://localhost:4000/v1","models":["gpt-4o"]}]

id.description: Connection id used in model refs, e.g. litellm

models.description: Bare model names offered in the dropdown; omit to use catalog defaults for the kind

plato.model.description: Default model as connection:model (e.g. litellm:gpt-4o). The header dropdown overrides this per chat.

plato.reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it (o4-mini, Claude extended thinking). Ignored otherwise.

plato.observer.enable.description: Observer-AI (D30): a second model watches each run and can inject guidance, pause, or cancel.

plato.observer.model.description: Observer model as connection:model (e.g. anthropic:claude-3-5-haiku-latest). Empty = use the coder's model.

plato.observer.role.description: Extra instructions for the observer (appended to its system prompt).

plato.observer.pause.description: Allow the observer to pause runs at safe points.

plato.observer.cancel.description: Allow the observer to cancel runs after the in-flight tool.

plato.observer.maxInterventions.description: Hard cap on observer interventions per run.
